title: Zuckerberg's AI Mega Investment
full_monologue: **Mark Zuckerberg spent $65 billion on AI infrastructure.** That’s more than the GDP of some countries. Why? To power the next generation of AI tools. We’re talking about massive data centers, cutting-edge hardware, and global networks. This isn’t just about Meta—it’s about reshaping the future of AI. Imagine what this could mean for innovation. What do you think he’s building? Comment below.
